heading: Then / temporal correlation
text:
### Then / temporal correlation [LNLS.4.11]

Overlays [LTHE.2.4] (cross-pattern correlation in `then` sequences).

Cross-pattern correlation `where` clauses in `then` expressions are
subject to the same equality-anchor requirement as standard
multi-pattern rules (LNLS.4.3).  Each correlated pair of patterns
must share at least one EQ constraint.
